headline: STANDING NOW SAYS WHAT IT DID (2026-09-16): Adrian reported /ops/standing's Re-queue as dead. It was not — three POST /api/task-action returned 200 and ops#44 went ralph-parked -> ralph-ready. The confirmation was rendering ~1500px above the button he tapped, and the row did not change lane for 60s. A CONFIRMATION HAS TO RENDER WHERE THE THUMB IS: an invisible success is worse than a dead button, because it teaches the operator the surface lies. Fixed, plus the four things the lanes could not do — age (open-days, oldest first; updated_at is unusable because the loop bumps it), a repo filter, expandable lanes, per-row Unblock + p0, and a 'The loop' section that distinguishes a wedged loop from an idle one. PREVIOUS: main is green and the chain tells the truth (#342, #322). THE FUNNEL STILL READS 0 CONTACTED.
